newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TI Group secures Forsheda holding in takeover war.
newsitem.headline: TI Group secures Forsheda holding in takeover war.

text.p: British engineering firm TI Group on Friday announced that it had secured 63.6 percent of votes and 20.6 percent of capital in Swedish engineering company Forsheda.
The announcement came after Henderson Investors, which controls 13 percent of Forsheda, announced it had rejected a 189 million stg takeover bid by TI.

"TI has received irrevocably undertakings to accept the offer in respect of shareholdings representing in total 63.6 percent of voting rights in Forsheda and 20.6 percent of the issued share capital," the company said.
TI said it noted Henderson's comments.
"TI believes that its offer is full and fair to Forsheda shareholders," it added.
"The offer has been recommended by Forsheda's board based on a fairness opinion by Forsheda's financial advisors, Enskilda Securities."
TI announced the proposed acquisition of Forsheda earlier this month, a move which would make it one of the world's top three suppliers of polymer-engineered industrial seals in its chosen areas.
Forsheda recommended shareholders accept the takeover bid which is open from October 14 to November 8.

The offer is conditional on TI gaining control of over 90 percent of the voting rights in Forsheda, but TI said at the time it retained the right to complete the acquistion even if this condition was not fulfilled.
